references.text: Peter insists that he will not deny Jesus, even after being warned.
Peter expresses similar confidence in the Gospel of Mark that he will not fall away.
In the Gospel of Luke, Peter also expresses his loyalty to Jesus, which mirrors his statement in Matthew.
The Gospel of John also contains a scene where Peter expresses his willingness to follow Jesus, which can be seen in connection with his statement in Matthew.

Although not directly related, Isaiah's prophecy about the Messiah being led like a lamb to slaughter may reflect on the kind of faithfulness and challenges the disciples, including Peter, would face.
